did.unittitle: Norfolk, N.Y. First Congregational Church records, 1892-1934.
did.abstract: The First Congregational Church in Norfolk, N.Y. was likely gathered in 1836 and likely dissolved around 1936. The collection contains a single volume of church records which include meeting minutes, membership lists, and baptismal records.

acqinfo.head: Acquisition Information
acqinfo.p: Materials were donated to the Congregational Library & Archives by the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ in 1979; no accession number.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: Materials in this collection were given to the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ at an unknown time, likely following the church's dissolution. This collection was originally processed as part of the New York Conference records (RG0112) circa 1980.

processinfo.head: Processing Information
processinfo.p: This collection was processed by Zachary Bodnar, September 2026, according to the rules of Describing Archives: A Content Standard.

bioghist.head: Historical Note
bioghist.p: The First Congregational Church in Norfolk, N.Y. was likely gathered in 1836. It may have begun as a Presbyterian church. At some point, the earliest record books of the church were lost to fire. The church likely dissolved around 1936.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains a single volume of church records from the First Congregational Church in Norfolk, New York. The church records include the minutes of meetings, membership lists, including those which are drawn from the record books lost in fire, and baptismal records.
